title_original: 독립유공자예우에 관한 법률에 의한 가족관계등록 사무처리규칙
full_text:
Article 4 (Duties of the Seoul Family Court)
(1) Upon receipt of an application from the Administrator of the National Veterans Affairs Agency for permission to create a family relations register, the Seoul Family Court shall decide without delay whether to grant permission.
(2) Where permission to create a family relations register is granted, the Seoul Family Court shall forward an original copy of the permission to the head of the relevant Si (Gu), Eup, or Myeon of the place of registration.
